course.title: Reinforced Concrete Structures - I
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: An 18 ft span simply supported beam carries a uniform dead load of 4 k/ft and a live load of 1.5 k/ft. The beam has a width $b = 1 2$ in. and a depth d=24 in. and is reinforced with six no. 9 bars in two rows. Check the beam for shear and design the necessary shear reinforcement. Given: $\boldsymbol { f } ^ { \prime } { } _ { c } = 3$ ksi, and $f _ { y t } = 6 0$ ksi. Use USD method.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
